officialJapaneseCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (Japanese)
officialJapaneseCatalog.evidence: Confirms LOVEBUZZ 58 as the Taiwan-made 158 cm standard men's model, complete size row, 2-ply 50/50 Paulownia Core, directional shape/flex, TripleRadius, Negative, Single Camber, P-TEX 3000 Graphite base, 1.8 mm stainless edges, and Japanese MSRP ¥85,000 before tax / ¥93,500 tax-inclusive.

officialProductPage.evidence: Current 26/27 product page identifies the model as the standard men's 158 cm size and describes the low camber, large sidecut radius, long nose, crescent tail, and intended all-mountain free-running use from groomed terrain to powder. This is manufacturer positioning, not a verified ride test.

officialTechnologyPage.evidence: Confirms season-specific GRAY construction context; the model-specific core and profile designation are taken from the Japanese catalog row.

correction.reason: The 26/27 official catalog row for LOVEBUZZ 58 lists nose width 300 mm. 286 mm is the LOVEBUZZ 48 row's nose width; all other checked 58-row geometry matched the catalog.
